ye+es gaubs kyis sdud pa'i phan tshig dri ma med pa'i bshes gnyen gyis ger snying go da ches grengs dbyeg gnyen dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3735">ka ma la shi la</rs>s rnaM bod pan las grengs pa 'grel chu nyid la ti ka chos kyi bshes gnyen ma zhes bya ba yod do dad na kodr nyis mdzad pa dang 'du lan tas kyang 'grel pa mdzad do || </seg></TEI>
